correction: v5 BranchRef selector-authentication taxonomy successor of 3a553

authority_contract.branch: one authenticated BranchSelectorV1 per branch in SELECTOR_SPACE
authority_contract.read: one retained CoherentView over one StorageRead
authority_contract.write: one PreparedPublication with exact selector CAS and one adapter commit
authority_contract.derived: lix_branch_ref is a read-only derived SQL projection, never a selector/control authority

deletion_order: replace BranchRef/BranchHead readers at session and SQL boundaries
replace BranchHeadControl fields and preconditions at transaction/publication boundaries
move init/create/switch/delete/undo/redo/checkpoint to selector views and prepared publications
move working-diff and schema generation reads to one coherent view
move GC roots/races to selector/catalog/object roots and exact publication CAS
delete legacy branch modules, spaces, stage rows, caches, and reexports
compile-fail all old consumers, then run adapter oracle
deferred_public_projection: lix_branch_ref remains only as a derived SQL surface until its projection is migrated
derived lix_branch_ref rows must never be read as durable branch authority
direct SQL entity/PK/columnar and physical row-group lanes are separate
model_requirements: fingerprint active branch, histories, object/liveness/allocation sets
fingerprint authenticated catalog object identity, kind, and selector back-edge
fingerprint retained-read branch/root/global selector ownership fields
fingerprint global/branch selector keys, roots, generations, selector bytes, catalog root, auth tags, and owner identities
acquire one retained read for create-branch and carry its exact nonzero read_id through publication
bind retained read ownership to branch identity, branch snapshot, global selector key/root/epoch/generation
reject create or update publication with zero, released, foreign-branch, root-mismatched, or global-mismatched read ownership before any write
distinguish same-owner stale CAS from unrelated-owner CAS with no partial write
reject a derived BranchRef/second authority before selector publication
open_view and reopen require an existing, authenticated selector-catalog object with canonical object ID, kind, and global-selector back-edge
open_view and reopen require physically present and live global roots, branch snapshots, and catalog closure
classify absent or non-live global, branch-snapshot, and catalog closure as MissingRoot
retain CorruptSelector for malformed selector authentication and embedded branch-identity mismatch
exercise malformed global and branch selector authentication as CorruptSelector
prepare_branch and update publication reject non-live objects and never resurrect them
exercise create, switch, advance, delete, retire, retained-view GC, and cold reopen transitions
reopen validates global selector sequence and branch selector bindings
malformed branch identity and branch deletion fail closed
empty undo/redo are no-op with no partial publication
every multi-selector operation is atomic with no partial state
